🎓 Grade Ladder

Climb from Grade 1 to Grade 12. One question per grade — how far can you get?

How it works

At each grade, pick 1 of 2 subjects, then answer a question at that grade's level. Get it right and you climb. Checkpoints at Grades 3, 6 and 9 lock in your points — a miss drops you back to your last checkpoint.

Helpers (one use each per game): 🔍 Peek — a classmate guesses the answer (usually right, not always!). 📖 Study Buddy — removes two wrong answers. Plus one 🛟 Classmate Save — a second chance if you miss.

Your classmates: Maya (Math), Leo (Science & History), Priya (English & Geography).

Just want to drill one grade? Use 🎯 Practice a Grade below — pick any grade and answer its questions for as long as you like, switching grades whenever you want.

🔊 Hear it read aloud: every question has a Read it to me button that speaks the question and all four choices out loud — handy for younger readers.


Pick any voice your phone offers — your choice is remembered on this device. iPhone note: Apple mutes the spoken voice while the phone's silent switch is on, so flip the side switch to ring to hear reading aloud. (The game's own sounds still play.)

Aligned to California's core curriculum (Common Core Math & ELA, CA NGSS science, CA History–Social Science). From middle school up, questions build toward SAT / ACT readiness — algebra, data analysis, evidence-based reading, and data-driven science.
